description: This bar chart, titled "Factual Errors," illustrates the number of factual errors made by three different question-answering systems—labeled in the legend as "NoR QA" (goldenrod with white dots), "OneR QA" (red with white dots), and "IRCoT QA" (dark blue with diagonal lines)—across four distinct datasets: "HotpotQA," "2WikiMQA," "MuSiQue," and "IIRC." The horizontal axis displays these four datasets in left-to-right order, while the vertical axis represents the count of factual errors, scaled linearly from 0 to 35 with major tick marks at intervals of 5. Each dataset is represented by a group of three adjacent bars, one for each system, with the exact error count labeled directly above each bar. For "HotpotQA," the "NoR QA" system had 15 errors, "OneR QA" had 10, and "IRCoT QA" had 5. For "2WikiMQA," "NoR QA" had 29 errors, "OneR QA" had 23, and "IRCoT QA" had 14. For "MuSiQue," "NoR QA" had 28 errors, "OneR QA" had 27, and "IRCoT QA" had 23. For "IIRC," "NoR QA" had 15 errors, "OneR QA" had 14, and "IRCoT QA" had 11. The bars are not sorted by height; they are presented in the order of the datasets along the horizontal axis. There are no visual emphasis elements such as shading, bolding, or annotations beyond the numerical labels.
